cohort: Two UK cohorts: 15,580 infants born 2000-2002 and 392,145 infants born 2002-2016
finding: Infants born by planned caesarean section had a moderately increased risk of hospital admission for LRTI during infancy compared to infants born vaginally, and infants born by any type of caesarean section may have a small increased risk of hospital admission for URTI.
